resolutions: Password authentication, sign-out, server-managed BFF cookies, rotation, policy expiry and immediate idempotent revocation already have authority in FRD17/ADR0006/FigJam38/40/41. Do not create a duplicate business decision.
PDR0011/AMD0007 supersede old PDR0007 age-only denial. A minor age classification by itself must not deny authentication or a normal Tunner session.

Production policy values, assurance mappings, processing and retention references are supplied by effective trusted versioned sources, not invented constants. Missing runtime providers fail unavailable; isolated fixtures are explicitly synthetic.
FigmaLogin2:4 GitHub button conflict is explicitly recognized by AMD0008/Doc31; Product Owner now instructs Google/Microsoft only and GitHub in future updates.
Other visual deviations remain limited to a prepared two-scope proposal; no generic proceed or earlier five-screen acceptance is treated as approval for a new signed-in screen.
OpenIddict Product grants, federation, step-up, devices, recovery, Account restriction mutations and cross-Product session termination retain their separate work-item owners.
implementation_boundary: Prepare and activate an explicit backend-only child for persistence/application/BFF HTTP tests if UI consent remains pending. Parent acceptance and affected production UI stay gated. No source implementation before the corresponding native eligibility check.
